title: Classify Threat Vectors
prompt: Classify each situation into the correct threat vector family (15 categories from objective §2.3).

items.label: Multi-month campaign with custom tools targeting a research laboratory
SMS smishing with a link to a fake banking portal
QR code stuck onto a payment terminal that opens a fake website
Office document with a macro enabled upon opening
Browser extension that exfiltrates session cookies
Compromised branch router used as an entry point
Exposed RDP connection accessed with stolen credentials
PowerShell used to execute a command without dropping a file
Compromised software update from a trusted vendor
Malicious USB flash drive plugged into a workstation
Contractor posing as a technician to gain access to the office
Unpatched connected camera used to scan the network
Industrial PLC / SCADA targeted via its control network
Tailgating behind an employee to pass through a mantrap
NFC badge read remotely by a hostile phone

explain: Classify by entry path, not by the final tool: a QR code is image-based, cookie theft is browser-based, USB is external media-based, and an NFC badge is signal-based. Concepts like QR/RCS/Bluetooth/RF/NFC come from objective §2.3.
